name: Camp Woonasquatucket
description_short: An environmental education day camp (Mon-Fri, 9 AM-3 PM) at the Leo Bouchard Conservation Center in Smithfield, RI, for ages 8-13 (now also age 7). Campers hike forests and wetlands, watch wildlife and birds, do science experiments, study bugs, make upcycled nature crafts and take part in conservation projects.
activities: Wildlife observation, animal tracking and bird watching
swim_waterfront_notes: The center has a canoe/kayak launch and campers 'splash into aquatic life'. The page does not say whether there is swimming, boating or lifeguard supervision.

sources.note: '2026 CAMP. Location: Leo Bouchard Conservation Center, 5 Waterview Drive, Smithfield, RI 02917. When: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Tuition: $400 per camper ... Ages: 8-13 years old *NOW ACCEPTING AGES 7'; sessions July 6-10, 13-17, 20-24; 'Need-based scholarships are available'. Phone is WRWC's office in the page footer.

source.title: Camp Woonasquatucket! - Woonasquatucket River Watershed Council

warnings: This is an old season. The page is a WRWC blog post dated March 7, 2025, and all session dates are for summer 2025, which has already passed (today is 2026-10-13). No 2026 or 2027 dates, prices or ages are shown.
The source is a blog post on the operator's website, not a dedicated camp page or registration page.
Registration goes through the Town of Smithfield Parks & Recreation site, but the link was not included in the source.
The phone number and the address at 45 Eagle Street, Providence are for WRWC's main office, not the camp site.
This is a half-day program (9 AM–12 PM). Each session holds up to 15 campers.
There is a 50% sibling discount for the second child. The $250 tuition is assumed to be per one-week session.

refund_policy_summary: Full payment due at registration. Cancellations at least 10 days before the session are refunded minus a $50 processing fee; no refunds within 10 days. Full refund if a session is canceled for low enrollment. 50% off for the second child.
